arms-raised-in-a-v/poetry/untitled-1.title: Untitled 1
arms-raised-in-a-v/poetry/untitled-1.content:
There is something beautiful
in text and type and books
their spines broken              or not
by one trying to extract their juice
and in the text: a stamp
of what though?
An impression
of the senses ~ an approximation
but not the thing              itself

arms-raised-in-a-v/poetry/untitled.title: untitled
arms-raised-in-a-v/poetry/untitled.content:
filling the future
with projections
like Brad Pitt
splicing images on the back wall
of Plato’s cave
reality overflows
with disappointment
unable to contain
all the half-conscious
expectations
